SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(ol.quantity * (ol.unit_price_cents - p.unit_cost_cents)), 0) AS gross_margin_cents,
  COUNT(*) AS row_count
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN products p ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
WHERE o.status = 'closed'
  AND p.category = 'sensors';
